name: Thomas' Original Plain English Muffins (Fork-Split)
whyItWorks: A light, yeast-leavened flat bread with 'nooks and crannies' made from refined white flour. When toasted, it becomes pleasantly crisp on the edges while remaining tender inside, absorbing butter with minimal fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Split open gently with a fork and toast until golden. Spread with butter or seedless strawberry jelly.
watchOuts: Avoid whole wheat or multigrain English muffin varieties.
